_comment: Cookie Run OvenBreak — auto Gift Draw box opener. Standalone loop (separate from coinrun.json run-grind). Precondition: sit on the OPEN 'Gift Draw' popup (home -> tap the Rewards gift-box icon, badge shows remaining draws). Loop: gift_draw(tap Draw) -> pick_box(tap a box) -> reward(tap Draw again when present, else Confirm). Most cycles hit the 'Draw again' branch and skip straight from reward back to pick_box, bypassing gift_draw's Draw tap entirely; only the layout without Draw again routes back through gift_draw. Repeats until draws run out (Draw greys or Draw again stops appearing, pick_box never appears -> pick_box absent -> done closes the popup and stops). RARE CASE: a treasure reward shows a 'Congratulations! Treasure received!' popup whose Confirm may not match giftdraw/giftreward_confirm.png (and can also appear layered OVER the Gift Draw popup). The old self-loop on_absent + timeout_ms design made the engine raise FsmError there (timeout with goto==self) and die with the popup stuck on screen. Fixed with absent_retries grace windows (one retry ~= absent_wait_ms + poll_ms + capture ~= 1.4s) that fall through to a 'rescue' state which blind-taps the treasure-popup Confirm spot. All coords verified live @1920x1080 except the rescue blind-tap (estimated from a user screenshot 2026-07-08 — popup too rare to reproduce live).

gift_draw._note: The 'Gift Draw' popup is open (teal ribbon title). Tap the green Draw button (1385,915 — it carries the remaining-draws counter badge) to spend 1 gift box. Marker ABSENT is usually the post-Confirm transition still settling (~1-2s fade) — tolerated by absent_retries (3 retries ~= 4s grace). A SUSTAINED absence means something unexpected covers the popup (e.g. the rare 'Treasure received!' popup layering on top) -> rescue, never a self-goto timeout (that raises FsmError and strands the screen).

pick_box._note: 'Pick a gift box!' screen — 5 boxes, ALL give a random reward (choice is cosmetic). Always tap the bottom-right green box (1190,830) — closest to the Draw button spot, minimizes finger travel between cycles — then wait through the box-open + reward reveal burst animation before checking the reveal. Trimmed 3500ms -> 2000ms -> 1500ms -> 1000ms, each verified live (20 cycles, zero absent-retries). 1000ms is the floor: 700ms was tried 2026-07-20 and missed the reveal often enough to fall through the full rescue chain and burn the cycle budget with no useful taps — do not go below 1000ms without re-verifying live. absent_retries(3x400ms) below covers the remaining margin if the reveal is still settling. If this marker is ABSENT it means the Draw tap opened nothing = draws exhausted (Draw greyed) -> on timeout go to done. A brief absence right after tapping Draw is tolerated by self-looping until the screen renders or the timeout fires. (Self-goto timeout is safe HERE because on_absent is a dict goto to a DIFFERENT state — done.)

reward._note: Reward reveal ('Congratulations!'). THREE known layouts: (a) cookie — single centered Confirm, no 'Draw again'; (b) item (e.g. 'Double XP', coins) — Confirm LEFT + teal 'Draw again' RIGHT; (c) RARE treasure — 'Treasure received!' popup whose Confirm may render at a different scale and NOT match giftdraw/giftreward_confirm.png. detect tries giftdraw/drawagain_button.png FIRST (any-of, first-found-wins): when present (layout b) tap it to skip straight back into pick_box — spends the next draw without re-tapping gift_draw's Draw button, one less tap per cycle. Layout (a) has no Draw again button, so detect falls through to giftdraw/giftreward_confirm.png and taps Confirm -> gift_draw as before. (c) falls through absent_retries (5 retries ~= 7s on top of pick_box's 3.5s wait) into rescue, which blind-taps the treasure Confirm spot.

rescue._note: Unknown popup is stuck on screen (reached only after a full retry chain failed). One last template check — the rare 'Treasure received!' popup's Confirm DOES match giftdraw/giftreward_confirm.png (verified live 2026-07-08, score 1.00 at 962,853; the old config froze on it because the popup layers over the Gift Draw popup while the FSM sat in gift_draw's self-loop, not because of a template miss). The blind-tap at (962,853) is the backstop for any FUTURE popup whose Confirm does not match. After the tap, verify recovery via rescue_check instead of assuming.

peel_popups._note: Before the blind-tap backstop, rule out a launch/reward modal layered over the Gift Draw popup. Cookie Run drops these at any time (Daily Check-in, Power+ Treasure Rewards, Congratulations/level-up), each hiding the popup and NOT matching giftreward_confirm. Peel whichever is present back to gift_draw (the popup is still underneath). None present -> fall to blind_confirm, the original (962,853) backstop for an unknown Confirm. Shared templates/coords with boxrun_default.json.

peel_treasure._note: Power+ Treasure Rewards. Confirm (960,850) -> gift_draw. Absent -> peel_congrats.

peel_congrats._note: Congratulations! / level-up reward popup. Confirm (954,847) -> gift_draw. Absent -> blind_confirm (the original treasure-Confirm backstop).

blind_confirm._note: No known popup matched -> last-ditch blind tap of the treasure-reward Confirm spot (962,853, from a 2026-07-08 user screenshot), then verify via rescue_check. This is the original rescue on_absent action, kept as the final backstop.

rescue_check._note: Did the blind tap bring the Gift Draw popup back? Present -> resume the loop. Absent -> one grace retry (popup fade ~1.8s can outlast the 2.5s wait on a slow frame), then stop cleanly via done rather than risk blind-tapping an unknown screen again.

done._note: Draws exhausted or popup gone. If the Gift Draw popup is still up (marker present) close it via its X (1660,175) then stop. If already gone (marker absent) just stop. Either branch ends the run — never spins.

probe_inactive._note: Home-side inactive guard. 'You've been inactive for a while. The game will restart!' can queue on/over home after a long idle. Confirm (953,690) lets the restart proceed, then hand to recover_login to re-auth. Absent -> probe_prevresults.

recover_login._note: Login recovery step 1 (DevPlay title). After the inactive-restart the game reopens on the DevPlay title with the orange 'DevPlay Login' button (devplaylogin_marker, self=1.0). Present -> tap it (960,950) to open the account picker, wait for the fade, hand to recover_pick. Absent -> we may already be at the picker (or past login) -> recover_pick.

recover_pick._note: Login recovery step 2 (account picker). login_marker = 'You already have an account!' + CookieRun logo (name-agnostic). Present -> tap the top saved account row (1100,490), wait out the ~12s login + home load, re-enter start_state (gift_draw). Absent -> the picker isn't up (login already completed, or the title is still animating) -> go to start_state and let its own detection settle; if we're still on the title, home will be absent and the probe chain loops us back to recover_login.

guard_not_partyrun._note: Close Party Run's 'Select a Mode' screen (added 2026-08-06, same guard the bot configs carry). This errand runs on the home screen with the full template tree, so Party Run is reachable here for the same reason it was there: a tap in the top-right banner strip opens it, nothing else in this config can detect it, and every state then misses while the chain keeps transitioning — a log that reads healthy while nothing progresses. close_popup (not a bare tap) so a close that does not take says so in the log: the blind-tap version of this guard sat on Party Run for 38 passes in silence. partyrun_marker.png scores 1.000 on that screen and <=0.403 on every other captured frame, so the 0.85 threshold this config uses is as safe as the bots' 0.82.

recover_unknown._note: Watchdog recovery entry (src/fsm.py no_progress_goto), mirroring the bot configs. Reached when no progress state has been touched for no_progress_s OR when enough consecutive polls matched nothing that the screen cannot be one this config knows — see _BLIND_LAP_CYCLES. Home visible means there is nothing to recover, so rejoin at start_state; otherwise escalate to the restart, because a screen we cannot identify has no close button we can aim at. FOREGROUND CHECK ADDED 2026-08-19: on_absent now asks whether the game still owns the screen before walking the probe chain. Every state in that chain matches a game screen, so a screen that is not the game defeats all of them at once — caught live 19:01-19:11 when LDPlayer's own store (com.android.ld.appstore) opened over the running game: the bot jumped into a storefront for ten minutes, this recovery pass ran and could not help, and only the second watchdog fire would have cycled the app. require_foreground is a no-op when the game is in front, so the fire that recovers on its own (one of the two seen that day) still does.

recover_unknown_restart._note: Expensive half, and the one that always works. A screen with no marker has no button to aim at, so cycle the process instead: restart_app -> recover_login re-auths -> start_state. An errand loses nothing by restarting — unlike the farm loop it has no run in flight to forfeit.
